ns2:section.sectionText: Registration restricted thru 11/27 to College of Business students; LAS Finance, Actuarial Science, & Econ majors; and ACES Agri-Finance, Agri-Accounting, & Consumer Economics majors. Any remaining seats will open to all interested students at noon on November 28. Business Minors will not receive registration priority in spring semester. PREREQUISITES (ACCY 202 & ECON 203) WILL BE ENFORCED. Students who do not have the appropriate pre-reqs will be removed from the course.
